spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact spec change: the real return value of setMicrophoneActive()/setCameraActive(), promise settlement, and the not-fully-active InvalidStateError branch from w3c/mediasession PR 312.

interactive.rationale: Every panel is driven by real controls making real API calls; nothing is a static card.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature index blurb matches the ChromeStatus summary and the spec's framing.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers all three worlds (missing / legacy undefined / spec promise) plus a mismatched-pair detection branch.

conformance.rationale: New suite checks both setters exist, both return promises resolving undefined when fully active, and the detached-document InvalidStateError rejection; honest fails on legacy builds.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome 153 drive: probe button and migration button both exercised, table rows + verdict verified, full-page screenshot read; console and network clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry asserts cover the primary contract and the fallback branches explicitly; no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, WCAG AA pairs from the established palette, button bg/color always paired.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with accessible names, aria-live outputs for async state, visible focus, 44px targets.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v159/mediasession-return-promise-undefined-from-setmicrophoneactive-and-setcameraacti --merge: desktop ok, mobile ok, no horizontal overflow; concept exercised at 360px and 1280px.

openQuestions.title: Verify the promise world on a 159+ build
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153 here returns undefined from both setters, so only the legacy branch was observable. On Chrome 159+ confirm both rows flip to 'Promise', settlement timing renders, and the verdict goes green.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region async result status output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic results via aria-live polite regions; don't spam interstitial states; one region per surface.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Async results land in dedicated aria-live=polite output/verdict elements; loading text is brief and only meaningful states are announced.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls layout mobile overflow grid
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap/grid with intrinsic sizing and overflow-x wrappers for wide tabular content so narrow viewports never overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control groups use flex-wrap, key/value grids collapse under 480px, tables sit in overflow-x:auto wrappers; verified at 360px via deno task responsive-check (no horizontal overflow).

guidanceConsulted.query: button toggle states accessible pressed semantics
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native buttons with programmatic state (aria-pressed/disabled) and visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Toggles are native <button> elements with aria-pressed kept in sync by script, 44px min height, and the design system's focus ring.

summary: Built and reviewed on headless Chrome 153: both setters exist and return undefined; the probe labels this the legacy world, the table rows and verdict agree, and the Promise.resolve migration pattern runs clean. Console/network clean.
